goal.objective: Add a focused behavioral Godot regression proving that when NeuralBrain becomes unavailable in neural-control mode, the real Agent does not fall back to utility selection. Create only tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd. The test must use the real World and Agent classes, put the agent in neural-control mode, make legacy utility capable of choosing an action, invoke neural_bridge_unavailable(), call select_action(), and assert that current remains empty and the agent waits for NeuralBrain. Then inject one valid NeuralBrain decision and assert neural-controlled actuation resumes. Do not modify production controller behavior.
goal.pass_definition: The focused headless Godot regression exits 0, demonstrates no utility fallback after NeuralBrain outage, demonstrates recovery after a valid neural decision, creates no repository artifacts, and tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd is the only changed file.

validation.command: from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys,tempfile; exe=Path('tools/Godot_console.exe'); assert exe.is_file(), f'Godot console missing: {exe}'; test=Path(r'tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd'); assert test.is_file(), 'focused outage regression missing'; log=Path(tempfile.gettempdir())/'birdai-neural-outage-test.log'; r=subprocess.run([str(exe),'--headless','--path','.','--log-file',str(log),'--script','res://tests/test_neural_control_outage.gd'],text=True,capture_output=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=90); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr,file=sys.stderr); assert r.returncode==0, f'Godot outage regression failed: {r.returncode}'; print('NEURAL_OUTAGE_REGRESSION: PASS')
